paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Office Assistant position at Orchestrate Consulting Group. With my background in event coordination and legal research, I believe I can contribute valuable administrative skills and a proactive work ethic to your team.

My experience coordinating large community events (International House Oulu) and managing client relationships in law firms (Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy) has honed my organizational, communication, and stakeholder liaison skills. At Poise Legal, I also gained hands-on contract drafting and negotiation experience, which aligns with Orchestrate Consulting Group's focus on coordinating carefully matched opportunities.

I am currently completing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), demonstrating my commitment to integrating international legal expertise with local systems. My fluency in both English and Finnish will enable me to effectively communicate within your diverse team.

Orchestrate Consulting Group's mission resonates with my own goals: connecting outstanding candidates with top-tier employers. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission and learn from Orchestrate Consulting Group's innovative approach to job matching.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
